A common training error of coaches is making the rest interval too short. For example, when athletes are required to jog or run to the next station with no recovery between drills, athletes tend to pace themselves and decrease the intensity so they are able to complete the workout. Athletes should be giving their best effort for each performance, which means adequate rest and hydration between sets and drills is required.
